requirements.statement: **MUST.** A known task intent MUST resolve through the authored route index before repository-wide search.
requirements.title: Route-first lookup

requirements.statement: **MUST.** A default route MUST load no more than seven canonical documents.
requirements.title: Default document budget

requirements.statement: **MUST.** A default route MUST declare a documentation budget no greater than 96 KiB.
requirements.title: Default byte budget

requirements.statement: **MUST.** A default route MUST declare a dependency depth no greater than three.
requirements.title: Default depth budget

requirements.statement: **MUST.** A missing route target or required section MUST fail the compiler and agent lookup.
requirements.title: Unresolved target failure

requirements.statement: **MUST.** An AIXEM agent MUST identify the owning authority layer before modifying an artifact.
requirements.title: Authority-aware planning

requirements.statement: **MUST.** An agent MUST retain the validation commands and evidence required by the scope before reporting completion.
requirements.title: Evidence-producing completion

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Normalized route IDs and aliases MUST resolve to at most one active route.
requirements.title: Unique route aliases

requirements.statement: **MUST.** A route MUST preserve an explicit ordered list of canonical document and optional section targets.
requirements.title: Ordered targets

requirements.statement: **MUST.** A route MUST declare objective completion conditions appropriate to its task.
requirements.title: Completion conditions

requirements.statement: **MUST.** An agent MUST run the narrow validator for the changed authority before release-level validation.
requirements.title: Narrow-first validation

requirements.statement: **MUST.** A schematic or documentation presentation change MUST include inspection of generated output at relevant viewport sizes.
requirements.title: Rendered review

requirements.statement: **MUST.** An agent completion report MUST NOT claim a validation command that was not executed.
requirements.title: No unexecuted claims

requirements.statement: **MUST.** An agent or build MUST stop when a required locked digest does not match.
requirements.title: Digest mismatch stop

requirements.statement: **MUST.** An agent MUST stop when a required canonical source or route target is absent.
requirements.title: Missing canonical source stop

requirements.statement: **MUST.** A renderer MUST stop when a required project or symbol feature is unsupported.
requirements.title: Unsupported required feature stop

requirements.statement: **MUST.** A composite authoring task MUST execute declared child routes in order and satisfy each stage exit condition before advancing.
requirements.title: Ordered route chaining

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Each child route in a composite authoring task MUST remain within the configured seven-document, ninety-six-KiB, depth-three retrieval budget.
requirements.title: Bounded stage retrieval

requirements.statement: **MUST.** An agent MUST read the route-selected format and renderer contracts before inspecting renderer implementation for ordinary authoring behavior.
requirements.title: Documentation before implementation archaeology

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Every P0 blocking authoring failure MUST be emitted with a stable diagnostic code and schema-valid machine-readable envelope.
requirements.title: Stable diagnostic envelope

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Every P0 diagnostic MUST identify the authoritative owner and an existing narrow remediation route without requiring prose parsing.
requirements.title: Authority-aware remediation

requirements.statement: **MUST.** A diagnostic MUST NOT identify generated SVG, resolved evidence, Viewer Model, Viewer HTML, or Workbench HTML as the authoritative final repair target.
requirements.title: Generated output is not a repair owner

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Each iteration change set MUST be computed from deterministic before-and-after snapshots rather than accepted from an agent declaration.
requirements.title: Objective change derivation

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Every authoritative file change MUST match both the active route authority set and its declared artifact patterns and constraints.
requirements.title: Route authority enforcement

requirements.statement: **MUST.** A hand edit to generated render or evidence output MUST be reported as a blocking scope violation.
requirements.title: Generated-output edit detection

requirements.statement: **MUST.** A composite authoring route MUST apply only the current child route write scope and MUST NOT grant a broad union scope.
requirements.title: Active child-stage scope

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Prepare MUST resolve the entry route, active child route, write scope, validators, task packet digest, baseline digests, and initial diagnostics before an edit begins.
requirements.title: Deterministic preflight

requirements.statement: **MUST.** A failed iteration MUST normalize diagnostics, select the smallest owning remediation route, enforce its scope, rerun narrow validators, and defer rendering until structural validity.
requirements.title: Authority-local repair loop

requirements.statement: **MUST.** The execution harness MUST expose an unchanged blocking state and an A-to-B-to-A state oscillation instead of silently repeating repair.
requirements.title: Non-improving loop detection

requirements.statement: **MUST.** A run record MUST retain the route chain, baseline and final authoritative digests, every iteration diagnostic state, change-set digest, executed validators, and final render evidence.
requirements.title: Complete iteration evidence

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Equivalent recorded artifacts, validator results, and execution metadata MUST produce a byte-stable run record and record digest.
requirements.title: Deterministic serialization

requirements.statement: **MUST.** A run MUST NOT close while blocking diagnostics, scope violations, generated-output edits, loop stalls, oscillation, or renderer nondeterminism remain.
requirements.title: Fail-closed closure

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Conformance evidence MUST distinguish deterministic Tier A harness/replay from Tier B live external agent execution.
requirements.title: Tier separation

requirements.statement: **MUST.** A release MUST NOT claim live-agent success unless retained evidence records an actually executed external agent and its executor configuration.
requirements.title: Truthful live-agent claim

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Workspace snapshot and execution paths MUST remain inside the staged root and MUST fail closed on symlinks or traversal.
requirements.title: Workspace path safety

requirements.statement: **MUST.** The release diagnostic registry MUST contain and route every P0 code declared by the 0.5.5 authoring plan, with no unknown authority or repair class.
requirements.title: P0 registry coverage

requirements.statement: **MUST.** An Agent Task Contract 1 document MUST be treated as a request envelope and MUST NOT grant an authority or artifact write that the selected task route does not own.
requirements.title: Task request is not authority

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Task write constraints MUST resolve as an equal or narrower subset of the active route authority, artifact patterns, prohibitions, constraints, and validators.
requirements.title: Effective scope only narrows

requirements.statement: **MUST.** A live attempt MUST resolve one executable active route before stage materialization; a simple route cannot select an unrelated route and a composite route must select one declared child stage.
requirements.title: Executable route is fixed before staging

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Equivalent task, route pack, incomplete start state, and attempt ID MUST produce the same task, reference-pack, start-workspace, and stage digests in a fresh stage.
requirements.title: Deterministic fresh stage

requirements.statement: **MUST.** A cold-start stage MUST exclude evaluator invariants, scoring metadata, prior attempts, completed target sources, and completed target renders while permitting only general route-selected reference material.
requirements.title: Evaluator and completed target isolation

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Stage construction MUST require an empty destination, copy without following symlinks, keep task and reference roots read-only by contract, and fail closed on traversal or symlink input.
requirements.title: Fresh filesystem isolation

requirements.statement: **MUST.** AIXEM core MUST launch external agents through a generic argv-based subprocess descriptor and MUST NOT require a provider SDK in the authoring-conformance core.
requirements.title: Provider-neutral subprocess boundary

requirements.statement: **MUST.** The executor MUST enforce wall-time, output-byte, and observation-event bounds and MUST distinguish unavailable, started, failed, timed-out, and completed processes with observable execution proof.
requirements.title: Bounded execution and proof

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Credential values MUST NOT appear in executor descriptors or retained output; explicitly inherited secret-bearing environment values MUST be redacted while inherited variable names may be recorded.
requirements.title: Secret values are never serialized

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Retained agent observation evidence MUST contain only externally observable actions and MUST reject chain-of-thought, private reasoning, scratchpad, internal monologue, and prompt-transcript fields.
requirements.title: Observable actions only

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Observation events MUST use contiguous sequence numbers, safe stage-relative targets, declared event kinds, normalized capability counts, and a digest of canonical JSONL serialization.
requirements.title: Ordered digest-addressed event stream

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Evaluator-only acceptance data MUST use the declared small predicate vocabulary and MUST reject exact hidden source equality, golden-source restoration, completed-solution payloads, and arbitrary oracle file comparisons.
requirements.title: Constrained semantic predicate vocabulary

requirements.statement: **MUST.** The evaluator MUST score the agent's actual final workspace, MUST retain failed predicates, and MUST NOT patch, restore, or replace authoritative source before scoring.
requirements.title: Score actual final workspace without repair

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Invariant evaluation and deterministic rendering MAY create derived outputs but MUST leave the authoritative workspace digest unchanged and MUST fail if evaluator code mutates authority.
requirements.title: Evaluator cannot mutate authority

requirements.statement: **MUST.** One live attempt MUST bind task, stage, executor, observation, authoring run record, evaluator result, stage validation, terminal status, and self-digest in an immutable evidence object.
requirements.title: Digest-bound terminal evidence

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Attempt aggregation MUST require the exact declared attempt IDs, reject duplicates or omissions, and retain PASS, FAIL, TIMEOUT, EXECUTOR_ERROR, and INVALID_STAGE results in the denominator.
requirements.title: Denominator integrity

requirements.statement: **MUST.** A live-agent claim MUST require actual external-AI process proof, valid observation evidence, retained terminal evidence, and denominator integrity; deterministic fixtures and protocol-only runs MUST NOT authorize the claim.
requirements.title: Truthful live claim gate

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Agent Evaluation 3 MUST contain exactly L001-L012 with seven creation and five repair tasks, incomplete staged starts, task/evaluator separation, declared initial diagnostics, and no bundled completed target.
requirements.title: Complete cold-start corpus

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Deterministic protocol fixtures MUST remain Tier A only, and Tier B or a public live-agent claim MUST remain false until an actual external-AI executor produces retained execution evidence.
requirements.title: Tier A and Tier B are never conflated

requirements.statement: **MUST.** The harness MUST digest task, reference, and stage-manifest inputs before launch, recompute them after execution, detect additions, modifications, deletions, replacements, and symlinks, and block `PASS` when any immutable input changed.
requirements.title: Postflight immutable stage integrity

requirements.statement: **MUST.** On supported POSIX systems the executor MUST launch each attempt in a dedicated process group and terminate the complete group with bounded terminate-to-kill escalation when wall time expires.
requirements.title: Complete process-tree timeout cleanup

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Observation result and nested details strings MUST be sanitized before official retention using explicit inherited-secret values and conservative credential patterns; malformed raw streams MUST NOT be retained as official evidence.
requirements.title: Observation secret sanitation

requirements.statement: **MUST.** When write coverage is declared, observed write and delete paths MUST be reconciled with Change-Set paths while Change-Set remains authoritative; unavailable coverage and discrepancies MUST be reported without inventing mutation truth.
requirements.title: Observation and Change-Set consistency

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Every required official invariant MUST declare a machine-checkable basis resolving to an agent-visible task pointer, staged canonical requirement, or staged active profile; an unresolved or non-staged basis MUST fail the fairness audit.
requirements.title: Agent-visible invariant basis

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Before Tier B, non-AI test fixtures MUST prove complete PASS flows for symbol, semantic, layout, and project authorities and retain the declared executor error, failure, timeout, tamper, scope, generated-output, invariant, close, malformed-observation, and secret-leak fault paths without setting any live-agent flag.
requirements.title: Deterministic pre-live success and fault closure

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Retained attempt evidence MUST separate current repository release, corpus identity and revision, corpus baseline release, and protocol version; deterministic Tier A MAY use a fixed clock while actual Tier B evidence MUST use actual UTC execution time and results paths MUST be independent of the corpus location.
requirements.title: Portable and truthful execution provenance

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Representative readiness fixtures MUST execute `prepare`, `check`, and `close` from the staged reference pack without source-repository `PYTHONPATH` fallback, and every existing authoring route MUST have exactly one explicit pre-live readiness classification without adding a readiness-only route.
requirements.title: Reference-pack and authoring-route readiness

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Visual review MUST inspect validation evidence, resolved-scene data, and rendered output before a drawing task is declared complete.
requirements.title: Evidence-backed visual review

requirements.statement: **MUST.** A detected drawing defect MUST be repaired in the authoritative source that owns the defective fact before derived artifacts are regenerated.
requirements.title: Authority-local repair

requirements.statement: **MUST.** The platform MUST separate canonical authoring, compilation, validation, publication, and consumption responsibilities.
requirements.title: Bounded components

requirements.statement: **MUST.** The official documentation site and compiled agent indexes MUST be consumable without a runtime database or required remote service.
requirements.title: Static consumer outputs

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Canonical validation MUST precede generated-index compilation, site publication, and release manifest creation.
requirements.title: Ordered generation

requirements.statement: **MUST.** The internal release manifest MUST be created after all covered release artifacts and evidence are finalized.
requirements.title: Manifest last

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Authored documentation rules MUST reside under docs/ or an explicitly declared root governance file.
requirements.title: Canonical location

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Generated indexes, compatibility references, site pages, evidence, and manifests MUST reside in declared generated locations.
requirements.title: Generated boundary

requirements.statement: **MUST.** An incremental compiler cache MUST invalidate an output when its canonical content or declared dependency digest changes.
requirements.title: Content-derived invalidation

requirements.statement: **MUST.** A cache hit MUST NOT bypass canonical validation or change source authority.
requirements.title: Cache non-authority

requirements.statement: **MUST.** A normative requirement MUST have a stable repository-unique AIXEM-REQ-* identifier.
requirements.title: Stable requirement ID

requirements.statement: **MUST.** A requirement MUST declare a verification mode, validator, test reference, and evidence path.
requirements.title: Verification declaration

requirements.statement: **MUST.** The canonical body MUST expose every requirement ID declared in front matter.
requirements.title: Body presence

requirements.statement: **MUST.** A release-critical validator MUST emit a machine-readable result with check IDs, status, diagnostics, and observed metrics.
requirements.title: Machine-readable result

requirements.statement: **MUST.** A failed MUST requirement MUST produce an error and prevent release completion.
requirements.title: Error severity

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Evidence MUST record the actual observed value or artifact digest used to reach its status.
requirements.title: Observed evidence

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Every authored task route MUST have at least one successful corpus phrase that resolves to that route.
requirements.title: Retrieval corpus

requirements.statement: **MUST.** The release test suite MUST render and validate the bundled grid-controller project.
requirements.title: Example integration test

requirements.statement: **MUST.** The test suite MUST compare deterministic core generated digests across consecutive unchanged builds.
requirements.title: Deterministic core outputs

requirements.statement: **MUST.** The 0.5 release MUST inventory every file in the shipped 0.4 baseline used for migration analysis.
requirements.title: Complete baseline inventory

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Every baseline inventory entry MUST have a migration disposition and target or rationale.
requirements.title: Migration disposition

requirements.statement: **MUST.** The 0.5 build MUST generate a route-and-card compatibility reference tree from canonical documentation.
requirements.title: Compatibility reference build

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Every published release MUST record the release-declared number of completed independent refinement and validation passes, never fewer than three.
requirements.title: Minimum repeated verification

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Every release-critical automated check MUST pass before the release manifest is finalized.
requirements.title: All checks pass

requirements.statement: **MUST.** The distributed ZIP archive MUST pass integrity, traversal-safety, and checksum verification.
requirements.title: Archive verification

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Semantic source data MUST be the authority for entity, endpoint, net, and no-connect identity.
requirements.title: Semantic authority

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Coincident or crossing geometry MUST NOT create semantic connectivity.
requirements.title: Geometry isolation

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Every endpoint referenced by a net or no-connect declaration MUST resolve to a declared semantic endpoint.
requirements.title: Endpoint closure

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Each behavior or data field MUST have one declared authority layer.
requirements.title: Single owning layer

requirements.statement: **MUST.** A generated artifact MUST NOT supersede the canonical source from which it was derived.
requirements.title: Derived artifact discipline

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Every semantic component instance MUST resolve to exactly one component type in a locked library.
requirements.title: Type closure

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Component endpoint IDs MUST be stable and MUST NOT be inferred from visual pin order.
requirements.title: Endpoint identity

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Every presentation port MUST map deterministically to a semantic endpoint.
requirements.title: Presentation binding

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Net membership MUST be declared as endpoint references in semantic source data.
requirements.title: Explicit membership

requirements.statement: **MUST.** An endpoint MUST NOT be both a member of a net and explicitly marked no-connect.
requirements.title: No contradictory intent

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Symbol geometry MUST be authored independently from proprietary vendor libraries and screenshots.
requirements.title: Independent symbol assets

requirements.statement: **MUST.** A symbol port map MUST resolve each visible port to exactly one semantic endpoint.
requirements.title: Deterministic port map

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Every semantic entity selected for presentation MUST have one valid layout placement.
requirements.title: Placement closure

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Layout data MUST NOT redefine entity, endpoint, or net membership.
requirements.title: Layout non-authority

requirements.statement: **MUST.** A project build MUST verify the digest of every locked source, library, symbol, layout, and style input before rendering.
requirements.title: Locked inputs

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Generated indexes and manifests MUST use stable ordering and controlled generation metadata.
requirements.title: Stable generated metadata

requirements.statement: **MUST.** An unchanged canonical source tree MUST reproduce equivalent generated documentation and reference indexes.
requirements.title: Rebuild equivalence

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Every authored Markdown file MUST resolve to exactly one declared repository document role.
requirements.title: Exact repository document role

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Root Markdown and reserved special filenames MUST be limited to the explicit policy allowlists.
requirements.title: Root hygiene and reserved names

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Every human-authored document MUST be discoverable through the official mechanism declared for its role.
requirements.title: Role-aware discoverability

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Canonical documents MUST end at the canonical footer and MUST NOT contain release patch append markers.
requirements.title: Canonical current-state structure

requirements.statement: **MUST.** A canonical path migration MUST preserve document identity and produce a validated prior-path redirect.
requirements.title: Stable identity across path migration

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Canonical domain and kind values MUST use the controlled metadata vocabulary and size estimates MUST be machine checked.
requirements.title: Controlled metadata vocabulary

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Identical authored inputs MUST produce a byte-identical repository document inventory and path migration index.
requirements.title: Deterministic repository inventory

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Implementation plans and human validation reports MUST be version scoped and registered by their lifecycle owner.
requirements.title: Version-scoped plan and report lifecycle

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Repository agent instructions MUST require role, owner, discovery, lifecycle, naming, and validation decisions before creating a document.
requirements.title: Agent document creation gate

requirements.statement: **MUST.** A Markdown path that matches no declared role MUST fail repository documentation validation.
requirements.title: Unknown Markdown fails closed

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Every approved root Markdown link MUST resolve safely, the root reference map MUST link every policy-required repository area and build control, and every human-authored Markdown document MUST be reachable from the primary root entrypoint.
requirements.title: Root reference-chain integrity

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Every canonical category index MUST link every document registered in its navigation section.
requirements.title: Complete category-index coverage

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Operational root entrypoints, current release navigation, planning, validation, route paths, and release metadata MUST agree with VERSION.
requirements.title: Current-release coherence

requirements.statement: **MUST.** A normative authority scope MUST have exactly one owner unless the repository document policy explicitly declares that scope shareable.
requirements.title: Unambiguous normative authority scope

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Every canonical Markdown document MUST contain front matter that validates against the active document metadata schema.
requirements.title: Metadata presence

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Every canonical document MUST have a repository-unique stable ID.
requirements.title: Stable unique ID

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Every 0.5 canonical document and generated documentation page MUST be written in English.
requirements.title: English release language

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Every release artifact declared in authored metadata MUST resolve to one canonical owner or an explicitly generated owner class.
requirements.title: Resolvable ownership

requirements.statement: **MUST.** A build or agent MUST stop when active normative authorities conflict and no explicit precedence resolves the conflict.
requirements.title: Fail-closed conflict

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Generated documentation and reference files MUST be regenerated from canonical sources rather than maintained as independent authored rules.
requirements.title: Generated edit prohibition

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Document metadata MUST include identity, status, version, language, domain, kind, summary, authority, aliases, agent policy, relationships, navigation, artifacts, and requirements.
requirements.title: Required metadata fields

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Every depends_on and related document ID MUST resolve to a canonical document.
requirements.title: Resolvable relationships

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Every normative requirement ID MUST be unique across the repository.
requirements.title: Unique requirements

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Generated indexes, compatibility references, and site pages MUST match the current canonical source digest.
requirements.title: Generated freshness

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Canonical Markdown and generated static-site internal links MUST resolve to an existing target and anchor.
requirements.title: Link closure

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Every normative requirement MUST have a validator, test reference, and release evidence artifact.
requirements.title: Traceability coverage

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Every shipped file covered by the release policy MUST appear in a verified SHA-256 manifest.
requirements.title: Release manifest

requirements.statement: **MUST.** A release MUST fail when an authored document declares an artifact path that is absent from the package.
requirements.title: Declared artifact existence

requirements.statement: **MUST.** An .aixem source MUST parse without duplicate entity IDs, duplicate net IDs, or unresolved endpoint references.
requirements.title: Semantic parse closure

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Required semantic features MUST be declared before use.
requirements.title: Declared features

requirements.statement: **MUST.** A component library MUST validate against the declared library schema.
requirements.title: Library schema

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Every symbol asset referenced by a component library MUST be locally resolvable and digest-locked.
requirements.title: Locked symbol references

requirements.statement: **MUST.** A style profile MUST declare a stable ID, version, unit, grid policy, and visual token groups.
requirements.title: Profile identity

requirements.statement: **MUST.** A style profile MUST NOT alter semantic endpoint identity or net membership.
requirements.title: Presentation non-authority

requirements.statement: **MUST.** A published release MUST have one explicit numeric release version using two to four dot-separated components and one immutable release identifier.
requirements.title: Release version

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Moving or renaming a published canonical document MUST NOT change its stable document ID.
requirements.title: Stable document identity

requirements.statement: **MUST.** An incompatible serialized-format change MUST increment the declared format or schema version and provide migration guidance.
requirements.title: Breaking format version

requirements.statement: **MUST.** A release MUST state which prior release artifacts or interfaces it preserves, migrates, replaces, or drops.
requirements.title: Explicit compatibility claim

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Every intentional breaking change MUST include a migration path or an explicit unsupported rationale.
requirements.title: Migration guidance

requirements.statement: **MUST.** A deprecated canonical document MUST identify a replacement document ID or a terminal deprecation rationale.
requirements.title: Replacement or rationale

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Deprecated IDs and aliases MUST remain resolvable during the declared compatibility window.
requirements.title: Discoverability

requirements.statement: **MUST.** A semantic source that declares interface ports or uses @PORT endpoints MUST declare hierarchical.interface@1 as a required feature.
requirements.title: Feature-gated interface declarations

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Every @PORT token in a net or no-connect statement MUST resolve to one unique top-level port declaration in the same leaf semantic source.
requirements.title: Real semantic interface endpoint

requirements.statement: **MUST.** An interface port MUST occur in at most one local semantic net and MUST NOT be both net-connected and explicitly no-connect.
requirements.title: Interface ownership closure

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Every semantic interface port in a hierarchical leaf MUST have exactly one valid sheetPorts presentation in aixlayout/2, and no unknown presentation may exist.
requirements.title: Total sheet-port presentation

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Local route paths MUST cover every connected @PORT endpoint using the semantic net that owns the endpoint.
requirements.title: Local route closure to interface endpoints

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Every aixproj/2 sheet record MUST identify one independent source and layout pair whose required digests are verified before resolution.
requirements.title: Independent digest-locked sheets

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Cross-sheet electrical equivalence MUST be declared only through projectNets members that resolve to semantic interface ports.
requirements.title: Explicit project-net membership

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Equal local-net IDs, port IDs, or labels across sheets MUST NOT imply project connectivity.
requirements.title: No implicit name merge

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Sheet parent relations MUST resolve to existing sheets, contain no self-parent relation, and form an acyclic deterministically ordered hierarchy.
requirements.title: Acyclic organizational hierarchy

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Interface ports already equivalent through one local net MUST NOT be assigned to different project-net IDs.
requirements.title: Project-net equivalence collision rejection

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Every valid aixproj/2 sheet MUST resolve and render through the production leaf pipeline as an independent SVG and resolved scene.
requirements.title: Independent leaf rendering

requirements.statement: **MUST.** A conforming hierarchical render MUST provide Sheet, Overview, and Composite views using resolved project data and sheet-qualified identity.
requirements.title: Three data-driven project views

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Three complete render runs from identical staged inputs MUST produce identical per-sheet, overview, composite, and resolved-project-scene digests.
requirements.title: Hierarchical render determinism

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Valid aixproj/1 and aixlayout/1 projects MUST remain valid and preserve their production drawing and resolved-scene bytes.
requirements.title: Legacy v1 preservation

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Release evidence MUST record three completed verification passes covering semantic structure, rendering and agent usability, and regression and claim integrity.
requirements.title: Three-pass hierarchical release gate

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Reference-profile symbol and schematic coordinates MUST be interpreted in millimetres.
requirements.title: Millimetre units

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Serialized coordinates MUST be finite numeric values.
requirements.title: Finite coordinates

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Translation, rotation, mirroring, and local-to-global transforms MUST be applied in the declared deterministic order.
requirements.title: Deterministic transforms

requirements.statement: **MUST.** A conforming project MUST declare the active schematic profile and required features.
requirements.title: Profile declaration

requirements.statement: **MUST.** A renderer claiming this profile MUST enforce its grid, routing, junction, and remote-asset policies.
requirements.title: Grid profile enforcement

requirements.statement: **MUST.** The serialized layout grid MUST agree with the active style-profile snap grid and the reference profile ratios MUST remain integral.
requirements.title: Active grid coherence

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Placement assistance MUST produce deterministic legal suggestions without mutating authoritative schematic, layout, project, library, or symbol files.
requirements.title: Read-only deterministic placement assistance

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Every explicit layout document MUST validate against its declared schema version.
requirements.title: Layout schema

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Every placement and connection record MUST bind to an existing semantic entity or net.
requirements.title: Semantic binding

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Every rendered wire path MUST be reproducible from stored endpoint and via geometry.
requirements.title: Explicit route geometry

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Newly authored reusable component libraries and symbol assets MUST use a safe project-relative path below `library/electronics` or `library/architecture` with lower-kebab namespace segments and filenames.
requirements.title: Canonical new-artifact path

requirements.statement: **MUST.** A component claiming a concrete real-world part identity MUST provide manufacturer, part number, and source URI or be explicitly declared as a non-semantic-ready placeholder with a reason.
requirements.title: Source or truthful placeholder provenance

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Every component ID MUST own a reviewable identity, port inventory, minimum property contract, provenance status, and presentation binding, and geometry-only ID multiplication MUST be rejected.
requirements.title: Semantic component identity

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Structural render, part semantic review, placeholder status, bounded compatibility, and circuit-intent review results MUST be reported separately and MUST NOT be collapsed into one ambiguous pass claim.
requirements.title: Separated validation claims

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Datasheet-backed semantic-ready status MUST require review evidence bound to the exact component identity, source URI, library digest, and applicable symbol digest set.
requirements.title: Source-bound review evidence

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Stable component port IDs and `port.type` MUST remain the endpoint and basic electrical-behavior authority, while `metadata.pinSemantics` MUST use the explicit `aixem-pin-semantics-1` profile when present.
requirements.title: Electrical behavior remains port type authority

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Signal class, functional tags, polarity, differential membership, power-domain hints, capabilities, and alternate functions MUST remain orthogonal facets and MUST NOT create additional physical endpoints.
requirements.title: Orthogonal semantic facets

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Pin semantic profiles MUST reject invalid tokens, contradictory no-connect obligations, duplicate differential members, and malformed alternate-function declarations.
requirements.title: Pin semantic consistency

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Detailed source-dependent pin semantics on a datasheet-backed component MUST be covered by review evidence bound to the cited source and exact component state before semantic-ready status is granted.
requirements.title: Source-reviewed detailed pin semantics

requirements.statement: **MUST.** The bounded static compatibility precheck MUST report `PASS`, `WARN`, `ERROR`, or `NOT_EVALUATED` conservatively and MUST NOT claim voltage safety, timing correctness, simulation correctness, or production readiness.
requirements.title: Conservative compatibility outcomes

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Every project lock MUST validate against the declared project manifest schema.
requirements.title: Project schema

requirements.statement: **MUST.** A renderer MUST verify every referenced input digest before resolving the project.
requirements.title: Digest verification

requirements.statement: **MUST.** The reference project profile MUST deny required remote assets.
requirements.title: Remote asset policy

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Expected project outputs MUST declare a path, media type, and role.
requirements.title: Declared output roles

requirements.statement: **MUST.** The renderer MUST select variants in placement, presentation default, then symbol default precedence order.
requirements.title: Deterministic variant selection

requirements.statement: **MUST.** The renderer MUST resolve parameters from symbol defaults, selected variant defaults, and placement overrides in that order.
requirements.title: Deterministic parameter resolution

requirements.statement: **MUST.** The renderer MUST resolve fields from identity defaults, presentation mappings, semantic entity attributes, and placement field overrides in that order.
requirements.title: Deterministic field resolution

requirements.statement: **MUST.** The renderer MUST expose routed port positions under semantic component port IDs after symbol-port mapping and placement transformation.
requirements.title: Semantic port transform

requirements.statement: **MUST.** The renderer MUST reject missing or mismatched locked assets, unresolved mappings, hidden mapped ports, and unsupported required features.
requirements.title: Fail-closed input and feature resolution

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Equivalent locked inputs MUST produce byte-stable SVG, resolved-scene, Viewer Model, viewer, workbench, and render-manifest outputs.
requirements.title: Deterministic evidence output

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Every route connection MUST name an existing semantic net.
requirements.title: Net-bound paths

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Every route path terminal MUST resolve to an endpoint that belongs to the named semantic net.
requirements.title: Endpoint-bound terminals

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Route geometry MUST NOT add an endpoint to a semantic net.
requirements.title: No inferred membership

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Every reference-profile route segment MUST be horizontal or vertical.
requirements.title: Orthogonal segments

requirements.statement: **MUST.** A route path MUST NOT contain a zero-length segment.
requirements.title: Non-zero segments

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Route points MUST preserve deterministic endpoint-to-endpoint ordering.
requirements.title: Deterministic point order

requirements.statement: **MUST.** A route MUST respect symbol body and annotation clearance constraints declared by the active profile.
requirements.title: Obstacle clearance

requirements.statement: **MUST.** A route crossing MUST have an unambiguous junction or non-junction interpretation.
requirements.title: Controlled crossing

requirements.statement: **MUST.** A route terminal MUST meet the declared symbol port connection point without an unbound gap.
requirements.title: Endpoint access

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Every routed join between two or more path branches MUST be represented by a junction record when required by profile policy.
requirements.title: Declared joins

requirements.statement: **MUST.** A crossing of different semantic nets MUST remain non-connected and MUST NOT share a junction record.
requirements.title: Non-join crossings

requirements.statement: **MUST.** The reference schematic profile MUST use a 2.5 mm snap grid.
requirements.title: Default snap grid

requirements.statement: **MUST.** The reference schematic profile MUST use a 10 mm major grid.
requirements.title: Default major grid

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Every free route bend MUST align to the permitted snap grid.
requirements.title: Free bend alignment

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Every component placement origin MUST align to the active snap grid unless the profile declares a documented exception.
requirements.title: Grid-aligned origins

requirements.statement: **MUST.** The placement set MUST resolve every presented semantic entity exactly once.
requirements.title: Placement closure

requirements.statement: **MUST.** A multi-segment electrical join MUST have an explicit junction declaration when required by the active profile.
requirements.title: Explicit junction

requirements.statement: **MUST.** A route crossing without an explicit junction MUST render and validate as not connected.
requirements.title: Crossing isolation

requirements.statement: **MUST.** A no-connect mark MUST correspond to an explicit semantic no-connect declaration.
requirements.title: Semantic no-connect

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Pin name and pin number MUST be visually distinguishable by position, role, or style.
requirements.title: Pin text distinction

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Required annotation text MUST not overlap symbol bodies, pins, or route segments in the reference output.
requirements.title: Readable annotation

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Project-relative and documentation-relative paths MUST be resolved without escaping the declared repository or project root.
requirements.title: Path containment

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Reference release validation MUST reject required remote scripts, styles, fonts, images, and symbol assets.
requirements.title: No required remote assets

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Archive verification MUST reject absolute paths and parent-directory traversal entries.
requirements.title: Archive traversal safety

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Every symbol asset MUST declare deterministic bounds and an origin.
requirements.title: Declared bounds

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Every visible symbol port MUST have a unique port ID and a valid endpoint binding.
requirements.title: Port closure

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Port and field anchors MUST be compatible with the active schematic grid profile.
requirements.title: Grid-compatible anchors

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Port IDs MUST be unique within a symbol asset.
requirements.title: Unique port IDs

requirements.statement: **MUST.** The declared port connection point MUST be the geometric endpoint used by routing.
requirements.title: Connection-point authority

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Pin number and pin name MUST remain associated with the same semantic endpoint across compatible symbol variants.
requirements.title: Stable number and name

requirements.statement: **MUST.** A symbol asset MUST declare every required graphic feature and a renderer MUST reject unsupported required features.
requirements.title: Supported features

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Any raster image referenced by a symbol MUST be digest-locked and locally resolvable.
requirements.title: Locked raster content

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Every symbol asset MUST validate against the active AIXEM symbol schema before use.
requirements.title: Schema validation

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Symbol lint MUST reject duplicate, missing, or unresolved endpoint mappings.
requirements.title: Mapping validation

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Symbol lint MUST detect zero-length port stubs and text that violates declared bounds or required clearances.
requirements.title: Readable geometry

requirements.statement: **MUST.** A compatible graphic variant MUST preserve the declared semantic endpoint set and endpoint IDs.
requirements.title: Endpoint-preserving compatibility

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Project and library policy MUST select a symbol variant deterministically.
requirements.title: Deterministic selection

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Required symbol fields MUST use declared deterministic anchors and alignment rules.
requirements.title: Declared field anchors

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Visible fields MUST respect the declared symbol-body, pin, and route clearance rules.
requirements.title: Field clearance

requirements.statement: **MUST.** A symbol asset MUST validate against the declared symbol schema version.
requirements.title: Schema-conforming asset

requirements.statement: **MUST.** A renderer MUST reject a symbol that requires an unsupported graphic feature.
requirements.title: Required feature rejection

requirements.statement: **MUST.** All content required to render a symbol MUST be local, locked, and deterministic.
requirements.title: Local deterministic content

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Every active component presentation MUST map every semantic component port exactly once to an existing visible symbol port.
requirements.title: Total semantic port map

requirements.statement: **MUST.** A component presentation fieldMap MUST map symbol field names to semantic component property or entity attribute names.
requirements.title: Directed field map

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Electrical symbol port coordinates for the active grid-light profile MUST resolve to the 2.5 millimetre authoring grid.
requirements.title: Grid-aligned electrical ports

requirements.statement: **MUST.** The visible pin lead endpoint associated with an electrical symbol port MUST coincide with that port coordinate within renderer tolerance.
requirements.title: Visible lead and port coincidence

requirements.statement: **SHOULD.** Standard connector and integrated-circuit recipes SHOULD use 5 millimetre pin pitch and 5 millimetre visible lead length.
requirements.title: Standard pin pitch and lead length

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Default reference and value field anchors MUST remain outside the component body and clear of ordinary pin-name channels.
requirements.title: External identity fields

requirements.statement: **SHOULD.** Multi-pin symbols SHOULD group ports by engineering function and preserve a left-to-right signal-flow reading where applicable.
requirements.title: Functional pin grouping

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Required symbol body dimensions MUST be rounded outward to the active grid and repeated pin groups MUST reserve at least `(N - 1) × P + 2G` in the group axis.
requirements.title: Grid-proportional body sizing

requirements.statement: **MUST.** AIXEM drawing and presentation assets MUST use original code, icons, visual tokens, and symbol assets.
requirements.title: Original assets

requirements.statement: **MUST.** AIXEM schematic presentation MUST use original functional grouping and drawing tokens without copying a vendor product pixel-for-pixel.
requirements.title: Vendor-neutral drawing presentation

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Color and stroke choices MUST NOT be the sole carrier of semantic connectivity or endpoint identity.
requirements.title: Semantic color independence

requirements.statement: **MUST.** The schematic presentation profile MUST use local or embedded presentation resources and MUST NOT require remote fonts, scripts, styles, or images.
requirements.title: Local presentation assets

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Schematic evidence MUST remain visually inspectable at declared desktop and narrow review sizes without changing authoritative geometry or connectivity.
requirements.title: Responsive inspection

requirements.statement: **MUST.** The Reference Viewer MUST NOT create or modify semantic, layout, or project-composition authority.
requirements.title: Read-only authority

requirements.statement: **MUST.** viewer.html and workbench.html MUST implement separately declared Reference Viewer and Review Workbench profiles rather than nominal aliases.
requirements.title: Distinct Viewer and Workbench profiles

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Identical Viewer Models MUST initialize to the same mode, active sheet, layer state, empty selection, search state, and fitted viewport.
requirements.title: Deterministic initial state

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Hierarchical projects MUST expose Sheet, Overview, and Composite modes.
requirements.title: Canonical multi-sheet modes

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Viewer selection, search, and highlighting MUST use sheet-qualified identities wherever local names can collide.
requirements.title: Qualified object identity

requirements.statement: **MUST.** The same qualified object selected through the canvas, navigator, or search MUST resolve to the same inspector identity.
requirements.title: Selection and inspector closure

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Selecting a project net MUST highlight only routes and interfaces belonging to that declared project net.
requirements.title: Project-net highlight closure

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Layer visibility MUST remain scoped by sheet and MUST NOT create semantic changes.
requirements.title: Sheet-scoped layer state

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Every required canvas view MUST provide pan, zoom-in, zoom-out, and fit behavior.
requirements.title: Viewport operability

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Required Viewer controls MUST be operable through keyboard navigation.
requirements.title: Keyboard operability

requirements.statement: **MUST.** P0 viewer.html MUST load and operate without required network access or remote assets.
requirements.title: Offline self-containment

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Authored text MUST be rendered as inert text and MUST NOT create executable HTML or JavaScript.
requirements.title: Untrusted text escaping

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Reference Viewer runtime MUST make zero external network requests during normal operation.
requirements.title: No network side effects

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Required navigation and inspection capabilities MUST remain reachable in the declared narrow-viewport profile.
requirements.title: Responsive inspection

requirements.statement: **MUST.** The generated Viewer Model MUST validate against its published schema and contain no unresolved qualified-object references.
requirements.title: Viewer Model schema closure

requirements.statement: **MUST.** Three complete renders from identical staged inputs MUST produce byte-identical Viewer Model, viewer.html, and workbench.html artifacts.
requirements.title: Deterministic viewer artifacts
